svg.title: An A-G-C polynucleotide chain
svg.desc: Source image007: exact 5-prime A-G-C 3-prime sequence. Full deoxyribose and base chemistry. Phosphate joins the previous sugar3-prime oxygen to the next sugar5-prime oxygen. Two phosphodiester linkages, terminal5-prime phosphate and3-prime hydroxyl. Haworth stereochemistry retained.
